functions.name: ec_can_document
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.ec_can_document(p_data jsonb)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select ec_can_study(ec_data_study(p_data))
    and (
      not (
        coalesce(p_data ->> 'tipo', '') = 'contrato'
        or coalesce(p_data ->> 'tipo', '') ~ '^gasto_(remis|medicamentos)_comprobante$'
      )
      or ec_can_facturacion()
    )
$function$

functions.name: ec_can_record
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.ec_can_record(p_data jsonb)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select ec_can_study(ec_data_study(p_data))
    and (
      coalesce(p_data ->> 'recordType', '') not in ('gasto_remis','gasto_medicamentos')
      or ec_can_facturacion()
    )
$function$

functions.name: ec_can_facturacion
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.ec_can_facturacion()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select es_superadmin()
    or current_rol() = 'admin'
    or exists (
      select 1
      from ec_users u
      where u.org_id = current_org()
        and coalesce((u.data ->> 'activo')::boolean, true)
        and coalesce((u.data ->> 'facturacion')::boolean, false)
        and (
          u.data ->> 'authId' = auth.uid()::text
          or lower(u.data ->> 'email') = lower(coalesce(auth.jwt() ->> 'email', ''))
        )
    )
$function$

functions.name: ec_is_own_user
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.ec_is_own_user(p_data jsonb)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select p_data ->> 'authId' = auth.uid()::text
      or lower(p_data ->> 'email') = lower(coalesce(auth.jwt() ->> 'email', ''))
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.es_superadmin()

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.ec_user_study_ids()
 RETURNS text[]
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select coalesce(array_agg(distinct s.id), array[]::text[])
  from ec_users u
  cross join lateral jsonb_array_elements_text(coalesce(u.data -> 'estudios', '[]'::jsonb)) s(id)
  where u.org_id = current_org()
    and coalesce((u.data ->> 'activo')::boolean, true)
    and (
      u.data ->> 'authId' = auth.uid()::text
      or lower(u.data ->> 'email') = lower(coalesce(auth.jwt() ->> 'email', ''))
    )
$function$

functions.name: ec_can_study
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.ec_can_study(p_study_id text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select es_superadmin()
    or current_rol() = 'admin'
    or p_study_id = any(ec_user_study_ids())
$function$

functions.name: ec_data_study
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.ec_data_study(p_data jsonb)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select coalesce(
    nullif(p_data ->> 'estudioId', ''),
    (select nullif(p.data ->> 'estudioId', '')
       from ec_patients p
      where p.org_id = current_org() and p.id = p_data ->> 'pacienteId'
      limit 1)
  )
$function$
